blocks.text: For six decades, the Ramon Aboitiz Foundation, Inc. (RAFI) has walked alongside communities, guided by a belief that meaningful progress begins when people are given the opportunity to shape their own future. As RAFI marks its 60th anniversary this November 16, 2026, the Foundation reflects on a legacy that goes beyond programs delivered and milestones achieved. Its greatest measure is found in the people empowered, the partnerships built, and the communities made stronger through generations of shared work. What began with a spirit of generosity and a willingness to respond to the needs of others has grown into six decades of […]...
